description: Comparing a NUMBER with a BOOLEAN uses Snowflake's implicit numeric-to-boolean coercion: 0 is FALSE, any non-zero number is TRUE - so 1 = TRUE, 0 = FALSE and 2 = TRUE all hold, in either operand order, and a DECIMAL 1.0 coerces the same way. The idiom appears in real predicates as flag_expr = TRUE where the flag was computed with IFF(cond, 1, 0). Converted 1:1 from query/BooleanNumericComparisonTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE flags (name VARCHAR, hits INTEGER)
SELECT name FROM flags WHERE IFF(hits > 0, 1, 0) = TRUE
